rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 5 March 1991, Shri Dinesh Goswami (Assam), speaking on the Prime Minister's statement about police surveillance at Shri Rajiv Gandhi's residence, speaks of surveillance of 'the house of Mr. Rajiv Gandhi either as Congress President or even as former Prime Minister', and of surveillance 'against the powerful Congress President'.
